description: RDS master password as a string literal in the resource
note: Expected to MISS, and kept as a positive so the gap is measured. checkov's secret detection is EntropyKeywordCombinator: a keyword match must combine with a detect-secrets entropy scanner hit on the value, and those scanners match a quoted run of their charset only -- base64 (A-Za-z0-9+/=) or hex. The regex is `(['":=])\s*([<charset>]+)(['"]|$)`, so a value containing any other character has no token to score. `Sup3rS3cretPassw0rd!` has a `!`, which describes most human-chosen passwords. The id is 6 (Base64 High Entropy), not 10: the combinator's own secret_type is empty and the id comes from whichever entropy scanner matched. Labelled 6 originally, relabelled to 10 on a misreading of SECRET_TYPE_TO_ID, and back to 6 on reading the combinator -- the corrections log has both moves.
